Academic software/tools directory

/app/tools
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-on

Explain institution-provided and course-required academic tools, their eligibility and access steps. A listing never promises a free license or makes an external service already connected.

Stay in directoryContinue to provider
Permissions
  • Catalog read access does not grant vendor entitlement.
  • Course policy overrides a broad institution tool listing, including AI permissions.
  • No procurement, license administration or institution-admin UI is introduced.
Responsive
  • Cards become one column; drawer becomes full-width with persistent Close.
  • Long instructions and domains wrap; external action stays below eligibility facts.
Accessibility
  • Drawer has focus containment, labelled title and focus return to tool card.
  • Availability has text labels; provider links announce external destination.
Data
  • Catalog fixture: tool ID, purpose, role/course eligibility, license status, owner and expiry.
  • Course policy reference and last-verified metadata; no vendor credentials.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Unknown eligibility cannot render an unconditional 'free access' CTA.
  • A course AI prohibition remains visible even if tool eligibility is confirmed.
  • A failed catalog refresh keeps a dated last-known label and functional help.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • New academic workflow; proposed directory ownership and entitlement verification require partner discovery.
